paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.17% on average, with Hang Seng strongest (+3.57%) and Nasdaq weakest (-4.18%). Brent crude changed -11.43% to 102.14. Gold changed -0.18% to 4,044.3. Bitcoin changed +1.20% to 78,121.8672. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.952%, a relative move of -0.82%. Among the firms tracked, Evercore (+14.37%) and 3i Group (+10.70%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Menopause specialist sold in €2.6bn private equity deal (FT Markets). Carlyle and PAI Partners agree to sell women’s health business for almost double what they paid four years ago Deals and capital markets: CD&R pursues buyout of $40bn card processor Global Payments (FT Markets). Deal for US company would rank among largest buyouts in history Central banks and macro: Bank of Japan says 2% inflation goal reached after decades of deflation (FT World). Japanese central bank holds interest rates as expectations mount for December increase Central banks and macro: Fed holds fire on interest rates despite intensifying inflation (FT World). Central bank to vote on monetary policy seven times next year in shift from decades-old custom of having eight such meetings Geopolitics and trade: European oil majors lift buybacks as Iran war drives bumper profits (FT Markets). Shell boss says he does not want surplus cash to ‘burn a hole in our pockets’
